concept: RDS Multi-AZ: automatic failover on AZ failure
tests: Choosing a relational DB option that survives AZ loss with automatic failover and minimal management.
expected: RDS Multi-AZ: synchronous standby in another AZ, automatic failover. Triggers: "relational", "withstand loss of an AZ", "automatic failover", "minimal management".
why_not: Single-AZ — no failover; MySQL on a single EC2 — SPOF and manual management; DynamoDB global tables — not a relational DB.
